real-time-bidding-bid-optimization.v: The value to the advertiser of a conversion.
real-time-bidding-bid-optimization.\\text{price}: The price paid if the auction is won.
real-time-bidding-bid-optimization.\\text{win}: Whether the bid wins the auction; win(b) is 1 if bid b wins and 0 if it loses.
real-time-bidding-bid-optimization.b: The bid: the amount offered for this impression, the thing being optimised.
real-time-bidding-bid-optimization.B: The budget: total spend must stay at or below this limit.
real-time-bidding-bid-optimization.p: The predicted probability that the impression leads to a conversion.
real-time-bidding-bid-optimization.\\text{conv}: A conversion (purchase or sign-up); in p_conv it labels the probability of one occurring.

budget-pacing-controller.S: Spend so far at time t: S_t is the actual cumulative spend and S*_t the planned (target) cumulative spend.
budget-pacing-controller.\\mathrm{ThrottleVariance}: Penalty on how erratically the controller throttles bidding up and down; large when the throttle rate jumps around.

first-price-bid-shading.v: The value of winning the impression to the advertiser.
first-price-bid-shading.b: The bid actually submitted, shaded below value v to avoid overpaying in a first-price auction.
first-price-bid-shading.\\text{win}: The event that the bid wins the auction; its probability given bid b and context x is what the model learns.

floor-price-optimization-publisher.\\text{bid}: The bids received: bid_(1) is the highest and bid_(2) the second-highest.
floor-price-optimization-publisher.f: The floor price: the minimum price the publisher accepts, the thing being optimised.

audience-lookalike-modeling.\\text{seed vs non-seed}: The label: 1 if a user belongs to the advertiser's seed audience of known good customers, 0 if not.

identity-resolution-cookieless.\\text{same person}: The label: 1 if two device or identity records belong to the same person, 0 if not.
identity-resolution-cookieless.\\mathrm{TransitivityPenalty}: Penalty when links contradict each other: if A matches B and B matches C, then A should match C.

click-fraud-and-bot-detection-search.\\text{CPC}: Cost per click, the price an advertiser pays for a click; w(CPC) makes expensive clicks count more in the loss.

creative-optimization-bandits.\\text{regret}: Regret: the total reward lost, up to round T, by not always showing the best creative.
creative-optimization-bandits.T: The number of rounds (impressions) over which regret is added up.
creative-optimization-bandits.a: The creative shown in a round: a_t is the one chosen at round t.
creative-optimization-bandits.\\mu: The expected reward (click rate) of a creative: mu_{a,x} for creative a in context x, and mu* for the best creative in that context.

genai-creative-generation.\\text{brief}: The creative brief: the instructions and brand guidelines the model is conditioned on.
genai-creative-generation.\\mathrm{PolicyViolation}: Penalty when generated copy breaks advertising or brand policies.
genai-creative-generation.y: The tokens of the target ad copy: y_t is the token at position t.

search-ads-keyword-generation-llm.\\text{page}: The landing page content the model reads to generate keywords.
search-ads-keyword-generation-llm.\\mathrm{PolicyViolation}: Penalty when generated keywords break search-ad policies (trademarks, prohibited terms).
search-ads-keyword-generation-llm.y: The tokens of the target keyword text: y_t is the token at position t.

pre-launch-creative-performance-predicti.\\text{CTR}: The creative's true click-through rate measured after launch.
pre-launch-creative-performance-predicti.\\widehat{CTR}: The model's predicted click-through rate before launch.

multi-touch-attribution.\\text{conversion}: The label: 1 if the user converted after the sequence of ad touches, 0 if not.
multi-touch-attribution.\\text{path}: The sequence of ad touchpoints the user saw before converting or not.
multi-touch-attribution.\\mathrm{ShapleyConsistency}: Penalty when the credit given to each touchpoint disagrees with its Shapley value, its fair marginal contribution across all orderings.

marketing-mix-modeling-bayesian.z: Control variables such as seasonality, price and holidays: z_t at time t.
marketing-mix-modeling-bayesian.y: Sales (or another outcome) at time t.
marketing-mix-modeling-bayesian.x: Spend in channel c at time t.
marketing-mix-modeling-bayesian.\\alpha: Baseline sales when there is no marketing.
marketing-mix-modeling-bayesian.\\beta: The effect of channel c: how strongly its transformed spend drives sales.

uplift-modeling-campaign.c: The cost of treating one person: treat only if the estimated uplift exceeds it.
uplift-modeling-campaign.\\mu_1: Predicted outcome if the person is treated.
uplift-modeling-campaign.\\mu_0: Predicted outcome if the person is not treated.

frequency-cap-optimization.\\text{conv}: Expected conversions for person i at frequency f_i.
frequency-cap-optimization.f: The frequency cap: the number of times a person may see the ad, the thing being optimised.
frequency-cap-optimization.\\text{cost}: Media cost of showing the ad f_i times.
frequency-cap-optimization.\\text{annoyance}: A penalty for ad fatigue: harm caused by showing too many ads.
frequency-cap-optimization.\\mu: Weight on the annoyance penalty: how strongly it counts against the main objective.
frequency-cap-optimization.\\lambda: Weight on the media cost: how strongly it counts against the main objective.

cross-device-graph.\\text{linked}: The label: 1 if two devices belong to the same person or household, 0 if not.

email-subject-line-optimization.\\text{click}: The label: 1 if the recipient clicked or opened, 0 if not.

query-ad-relevance-matching.f: The matching model: its score for a query and ad pair, passed through the sigmoid to give a probability.
query-ad-relevance-matching.a: The ad being matched to the query.
query-ad-relevance-matching.\\sigma: Sigmoid function: squashes the score into a probability between 0 and 1.
query-ad-relevance-matching.\\mathrm{Distillation}: Penalty for disagreeing with a larger teacher model, so the small fast model copies the teacher's behaviour.

video-ad-placement-optimization.\\text{revenue}: Ad revenue earned by the placement.
video-ad-placement-optimization.\\text{abandonment cost}: The cost of viewers leaving because of the ad break, weighted by lambda.

feed-ad-load-and-yield-optimization.\\text{ad revenue}: Revenue from ads at step t.
feed-ad-load-and-yield-optimization.\\text{engagement}: User engagement at step t, protected so ads do not erode it.
feed-ad-load-and-yield-optimization.\\pi: The policy that decides how many ads to show.

app-install-prediction.\\text{install}: Label: 1 if the user installs the app after the ad.
app-install-prediction.\\text{day-1 purchase}: Label: 1 if the user buys within the first day of installing.

mobile-retention-roas-prediction.r: Actual return on ad spend (ROAS) at day t of a cohort: r_t.
mobile-retention-roas-prediction.\\mathrm{CurveMonotonicity}: Penalty when the predicted cumulative return curve goes down, since cumulative revenue cannot decrease.

ad-spend-forecasting-and-allocation.R: The response curve of channel c: expected return as a function of spend.
ad-spend-forecasting-and-allocation.b: The budget given to channel c.
ad-spend-forecasting-and-allocation.B: The total budget to split across channels.

cross-channel-budget-allocation.\\text{regret}: Regret: total reward lost by not always picking the best channel.
cross-channel-budget-allocation.\\mu: Expected reward of a channel; mu_a for channel a and mu_{a_t} for the channel chosen at round t.
cross-channel-budget-allocation.a: A channel (arm); a_t is the channel chosen at round t.

modeled-conversions-privacy.\\mathrm{AggregateConsistency}: Penalty when the modelled conversions do not add up to the aggregate totals reported by the platform.

differential-privacy-measurement.M: The randomised measurement mechanism that adds noise to the result.
differential-privacy-measurement.D: A dataset; D' is the same dataset with one person's data changed or removed.
differential-privacy-measurement.S: Any set of possible outputs of the mechanism.
differential-privacy-measurement.\\delta: A small probability that the privacy guarantee fails.
differential-privacy-measurement.\\varepsilon: The privacy budget: the smaller it is, the less any one person's data can change the output.

clean-room-audience-matching.\\text{match}: The label: 1 if two records match between the partners, 0 if not.
clean-room-audience-matching.\\mathrm{PrivacyLeakagePenalty}: Penalty when the matching process reveals more about individuals than the clean-room rules allow.

influencer-matching-and-fraud.\\text{fake}: The label: 1 if the account has fake followers or engagement, 0 if genuine.
influencer-matching-and-fraud.\\text{brand}: The brand's representation used for matching.
influencer-matching-and-fraud.\\text{creator}: The creator's representation used for matching.

content-virality-prediction.N: The number of views or shares after T hours: N_T actual, and its hat the predicted value.

retargeting-window-optimization.\\text{convert}: The label: 1 if the visitor converts after the ad, 0 if not.
retargeting-window-optimization.h: The hazard: the chance of converting at time t given that they have not converted yet, which determines how long to keep retargeting.

viewability-and-attention-prediction.\\text{viewable}: The label: 1 if the ad was viewable (on screen long enough), 0 if not.
viewability-and-attention-prediction.\\text{attention time}: How many seconds the user actually looked at the ad, predicted as a number.

ctv-audience-measurement.P: A distribution of audience over groups: P_panel from the measured panel and P_model from the model.
ctv-audience-measurement.\\mathrm{ConsistencyCensus}: Penalty when modelled audience totals disagree with census population totals.

conversational-ads-assistant.\\text{brand KB}: The brand knowledge base of approved facts the assistant answers from.
conversational-ads-assistant.\\mathrm{ClaimViolation}: Penalty for statements that break advertising claim rules or contradict the knowledge base.
conversational-ads-assistant.y: The tokens of the target reply: y_t at position t.

marketing-copilot-analyst-agent.\\text{schema,results}: The data schema and query results the assistant can see.
marketing-copilot-analyst-agent.\\mathrm{WrongQuery}: Penalty when generated queries are invalid or do not answer the question.
marketing-copilot-analyst-agent.y: The tokens of the target query or answer: y_t at position t.

bid-traffic-shaping-and-qps-throttling.v: The value of processing bid request r.
bid-traffic-shaping-and-qps-throttling.\\text{process}: Whether request r is processed (1) or dropped (0).
bid-traffic-shaping-and-qps-throttling.\\text{cost}: Compute cost of processing the requests.
bid-traffic-shaping-and-qps-throttling.Q: The maximum queries per second the system can handle.
bid-traffic-shaping-and-qps-throttling.\\pi: The policy that decides which requests to process.

network-intrusion-detection-flow-anomaly.\\mathrm{SemiSupervisedBCE}: Binary cross-entropy applied only to the few flows with known labels, which steers the unsupervised model toward real attacks.

endpoint-malware-detection.\\mathrm{AdversarialRobustness}: Penalty when small deliberate changes to a file make the model change its verdict.
endpoint-malware-detection.p: The predicted probability for each class (benign, malware families).

business-email-compromise-detection.\\text{amount at risk}: The money that would be lost if the email were fraudulent; w makes high-value cases count more.

soc-copilot-llm-investigation.\\text{tool results}: The output of the security tools the agent has queried, which is what its answer must be based on.
soc-copilot-llm-investigation.\\mathrm{UnsupportedClaim}: Penalty for statements in the verdict that no tool result supports.
soc-copilot-llm-investigation.y: The tokens of the target investigation write-up: y_t at position t.

threat-hunting-hypothesis-agent.\\text{CTI}: Cyber threat intelligence: the reports on attacker behaviour the agent reads.
threat-hunting-hypothesis-agent.\\mathrm{InvalidQuery}: Penalty when the agent writes hunting queries that are invalid or cannot run.
threat-hunting-hypothesis-agent.y: The tokens of the target hypothesis or query: y_t at position t.

vulnerability-prioritization-exploit-pre.\\text{exploited within 30 days}: The label: 1 if the vulnerability was exploited in the wild within 30 days of disclosure, 0 if not.

patch-risk-and-sequencing.\\text{incident}: The label: 1 if applying the patch caused an incident, 0 if not.
patch-risk-and-sequencing.\\text{asset criticality}: How important the asset is to the business; w makes mistakes on critical assets cost more.

attack-path-analysis-graph.S: The set of controls or edges chosen to block attack paths; the objective is to make |S|, its size, as small as possible.

ransomware-early-detection.\\mathrm{DetectionDelay}: Penalty that grows the longer after encryption starts the model takes to raise an alert.

cloud-misconfiguration-and-drift.\\text{exposure}: How exposed the resource is (for example, public internet access); w makes errors on exposed resources cost more.

llm-static-code-vulnerability-detection.\\text{code}: The source code the model reads and must analyse.
llm-static-code-vulnerability-detection.\\mathrm{FalsePositive}: Penalty for reporting a vulnerability that is not real, which wastes developer time.

ml-guided-fuzzing.\\text{new coverage}: The new code paths reached by the test input chosen at step t; the policy is rewarded for exploring more of the program.
ml-guided-fuzzing.\\pi: The policy that chooses which inputs to try next.
ml-guided-fuzzing.\\gamma: Discount factor: values coverage found sooner more than coverage found later.

ddos-detection-and-mitigation.\\mathrm{DetectionDelay}: Penalty that grows the longer an attack runs before it is detected.

threat-actor-attribution-clustering.\\text{same campaign}: The pairing label: 1 if two incidents belong to the same attacker campaign, 0 if not.
threat-actor-attribution-clustering.\\mathrm{ClusterCompactness}: Penalty that keeps incidents of one campaign tightly grouped in embedding space.

malware-family-clustering.a: The anchor: a sample whose family the triplet is built around.
malware-family-clustering.p: The positive: another sample from the same family as the anchor.
malware-family-clustering.n: The negative: a sample from a different family.
malware-family-clustering.\\mathrm{ClusterEntropy}: Penalty when a cluster mixes many families, since mixed clusters are less useful.

binary-code-similarity.f: The embedding of a compiled function: f_a and f_b are two versions of the same function (for example, different architectures or optimisation levels) that should end up close together.

email-attachment-sandbox-triage.\\mathrm{CostAwareDetonation}: Penalty that accounts for the time and money cost of running a file in the sandbox, so only files worth detonating are sent.

zero-trust-adaptive-authentication.\\mathrm{FrictionCost}: Penalty for the inconvenience of extra authentication steps imposed on legitimate users.

device-posture-risk-scoring.\\text{compromise}: The label: 1 if the device was later found to be compromised, 0 if not.

ics-ot-intrusion-detection.x: The sensor reading at time t from the industrial process; the hat is the model's reconstruction of it.
ics-ot-intrusion-detection.\\mathrm{PhysicsResidual}: Penalty when predicted readings violate known physical laws of the plant, such as conservation of mass.

security-log-parsing-llm.\\mathrm{CE}_{\\text{field mapping}}: Cross-entropy on mapping each log field to the right schema field.
security-log-parsing-llm.\\mathrm{SchemaViolation}: Penalty when the parsed output does not follow the required event schema.

detection-rule-generation-sigma-llm.\\text{TTP}: The attacker technique (tactic, technique or procedure) description the rule must detect.
detection-rule-generation-sigma-llm.\\mathrm{InvalidRule}: Penalty when the generated Sigma rule is syntactically invalid or cannot run on the log source.

alert-correlation-and-deduplication.\\text{alert pairs}: Pairs of alerts labelled as belonging to the same incident or not; triplet loss pulls related alerts together.
alert-correlation-and-deduplication.\\mathrm{ClusterPurity}: Penalty when a cluster of alerts mixes alerts from different incidents.

incident-response-playbook-agent.\\text{case}: The incident case details the agent reads to decide the next steps.
incident-response-playbook-agent.\\mathrm{UnsafeAction}: Penalty when the agent proposes a response action that is disruptive or not permitted.

red-team-attack-simulation-rl.r: Reward for attack progress: r_progress measures how far the simulated attacker advances.
red-team-attack-simulation-rl.\\mathrm{detection}: Whether the simulated defender detects the attacker at step t.
red-team-attack-simulation-rl.\\pi: The attacker's policy for choosing actions.

adversarial-ml-robustness.f: The model: f_theta turns an input into a prediction.
adversarial-ml-robustness.\\delta: A small adversarial perturbation added to the input to fool the model; its size is limited to epsilon.
adversarial-ml-robustness.\\epsilon: The largest allowed size of the perturbation.
adversarial-ml-robustness.\\theta: The model parameters being trained to resist the worst-case perturbation.

ai-agent-tool-permission-guardrails.\\text{unsafe}: The label: 1 if a requested tool action is unsafe, 0 if safe.
ai-agent-tool-permission-guardrails.\\mathrm{Latency}: Penalty for the extra time the guardrail adds to each tool call.

cyber-risk-quantification.\\mathrm{ALE}: Annualised loss expectancy: the expected yearly financial loss from cyber incidents.
cyber-risk-quantification.\\lambda: The expected number of incidents of type i per year (Poisson rate).
cyber-risk-quantification.L: The size of the loss in one incident of type i (log-normal).

adaptive-learning-path-recommendation.\\text{mastery}: The learner's mastery of skills; Delta mastery_t is how much it improves at step t.
adaptive-learning-path-recommendation.\\pi: The policy that chooses the next exercise.
adaptive-learning-path-recommendation.\\gamma: Discount factor for later learning gains.
adaptive-learning-path-recommendation.\\Delta: The change in mastery at step t.

irt-calibration-and-adaptive-testing.P: The probability that student i answers item j correctly under the item response model.
irt-calibration-and-adaptive-testing.c: The guessing parameter of item j: the chance of a correct answer by luck.
irt-calibration-and-adaptive-testing.a: The discrimination of item j: how sharply it separates strong from weak students.
irt-calibration-and-adaptive-testing.y: The observed answer: 1 if student i got item j correct, 0 if not.
irt-calibration-and-adaptive-testing.e: Euler's number, base of the logistic curve.

automated-essay-scoring.\\mathrm{OrdinalMSE}: Squared error between predicted and true scores that respects the ordered scale of grades.
automated-essay-scoring.\\mathrm{RubricTraitLoss}: Penalty for errors on individual rubric traits such as organisation or grammar, not just the overall score.

short-answer-grading-llm.\\text{rubric}: The marking rubric the model is given.

programming-assignment-feedback-llm.\\text{code,tests}: The student's code and the test results the feedback is based on.
programming-assignment-feedback-llm.\\mathrm{SolutionLeak}: Penalty when the feedback gives away the full solution instead of a hint.

ai-tutor-socratic.\\text{dialogue,curriculum}: The conversation so far and the curriculum the tutor must stay within.
ai-tutor-socratic.\\mathrm{AnswerLeak}: Penalty when the tutor states the answer instead of guiding the student with questions.

math-solution-step-verification.\\mathrm{CE}_{\\text{step validity}}: Cross-entropy on whether each solution step is valid.
math-solution-step-verification.\\mathrm{ErrorLocalisation}: Penalty when the model points to the wrong step as the first error.

pronunciation-assessment-speech.\\mathcal{L}_{\\text{CTC}}: Connectionist temporal classification loss: aligns the audio to the phonemes without needing frame-by-frame labels.
pronunciation-assessment-speech.\\mathrm{GOP\\ regression}: Loss for predicting the goodness-of-pronunciation score of each phoneme.

conversational-language-practice-agent.\\text{level,goal}: The learner's proficiency level and learning goal, which the reply is conditioned on.

reading-fluency-assessment-asr.\\mathcal{L}_{\\text{CTC}}: Connectionist temporal classification loss for speech recognition of the child's reading.
reading-fluency-assessment-asr.\\mathrm{Alignment}: Penalty when the recognised words are not aligned correctly with the reference text.

student-dropout-early-warning.\\delta: Event indicator: 1 if student i dropped out during observation, 0 if still enrolled (censored).
student-dropout-early-warning.h: The hazard: the chance of dropping out at time t given the student is still enrolled.
student-dropout-early-warning.H: The cumulative hazard: the accumulated risk of dropping out up to time t_i.
student-dropout-early-warning.t: The time at which student i dropped out or was last observed.

course-recommendation-career-paths.\\mathrm{GoalAlignment}: Penalty when recommended courses do not move the learner toward their stated career goal.

skill-graph-and-job-matching.\\mathrm{CE}_{\\text{NER}}: Cross-entropy for recognising skill names in text (named-entity recognition).
skill-graph-and-job-matching.\\text{person}: The embedding of a person's skills.
skill-graph-and-job-matching.\\text{role}: The embedding of a job role's required skills.

content-difficulty-estimation.b: The difficulty of a piece of content; the hat is the model's estimate.

question-generation-llm.\\text{objective,context}: The learning objective and source material the question is generated from.
question-generation-llm.\\mathrm{Unanswerable}: Penalty when the generated question cannot be answered from the given context.

mcq-distractor-generation.d: The tokens of the wrong answer option (distractor) being generated: d_t is the token at position t and d_{<t} are the earlier ones.
mcq-distractor-generation.\\mathrm{MisconceptionAlign}: Penalty when a distractor does not correspond to a real student misconception.
mcq-distractor-generation.d_{<t}: The tokens of the distractor generated before position t.

exam-timetabling-optimization.\\text{clashes}: Number of students with two exams at the same time in slot s.
exam-timetabling-optimization.\\text{consecutive exams}: Number of students with back-to-back exams in slot s.
exam-timetabling-optimization.\\text{room cost}: The cost of the rooms used.
exam-timetabling-optimization.\\lambda: Weight on consecutive exams: how strongly it counts against the main objective.
exam-timetabling-optimization.\\mu: Weight on room cost: how strongly it counts against the main objective.

classroom-allocation-and-timetable.\\text{preference violations}: Count of teacher or student preferences that the timetable breaks.
classroom-allocation-and-timetable.\\text{room waste}: Empty seats: room capacity minus class size.
classroom-allocation-and-timetable.\\text{gaps}: Idle gaps in a timetable between classes.
classroom-allocation-and-timetable.\\lambda: Weight on room waste: how strongly it counts against the main objective.
classroom-allocation-and-timetable.\\mu: Weight on gaps: how strongly it counts against the main objective.

teacher-copilot-lesson-planning.\\text{standards,context}: The curriculum standards and class context the lesson plan must follow.
teacher-copilot-lesson-planning.\\mathrm{StandardMisalign}: Penalty when the generated plan does not address the required standard.

curriculum-alignment-tagging.\\mathrm{HierarchyConsistency}: Penalty when a child standard is tagged without its parent in the curriculum hierarchy.
curriculum-alignment-tagging.y: The label for tag k: 1 if the content matches standard k.
curriculum-alignment-tagging.p: The predicted probability for tag k.

engagement-prediction-notifications.\\text{practice}: Practice done by the learner at step t.
engagement-prediction-notifications.\\text{optout}: Whether the learner opted out of notifications at step t.
engagement-prediction-notifications.\\kappa: How heavily an opt-out is penalised compared with practice.

spaced-repetition-scheduling.R: The probability that the learner recalls the item at time t: R_t = exp(-Delta t / S_t).
spaced-repetition-scheduling.S: Memory stability: how slowly this item is forgotten; higher means longer intervals.
spaced-repetition-scheduling.y: The review outcome: 1 if recalled, 0 if forgotten.
spaced-repetition-scheduling.\\Delta: The time since the last review.

admissions-and-student-support-chatbot.\\text{KB}: The knowledge base of approved admissions and support information the chatbot answers from.
admissions-and-student-support-chatbot.\\mathrm{PolicyError}: Penalty when the answer contradicts institutional policy.

scholarship-matching.\\mathrm{EligibilityPenalty}: Penalty for recommending scholarships the student is not eligible for.

peer-grouping-collaborative-learning.\\text{group value}: How good group g is for learning, for example the balance of skills and compatible schedules.
peer-grouping-collaborative-learning.g: Index over the groups of students.

discussion-forum-qa-and-moderation.\\text{toxic}: The label: 1 if a post is toxic or abusive, 0 if not.
discussion-forum-qa-and-moderation.\\text{question}: The embedding of a question post.
discussion-forum-qa-and-moderation.\\text{answer}: The embedding of an answer post that matches the question.

doubt-ticket-routing.\\mathrm{CE}_{\\text{topic}}: Cross-entropy for classifying the topic of a student's question.
doubt-ticket-routing.\\mathrm{Assignment\\ cost}: Penalty for assigning a ticket to a tutor who is overloaded or not suited to it.

gamification-reward-optimization.\\text{learning minutes}: Minutes the learner spends learning at step t.
gamification-reward-optimization.\\text{anxiety signals}: Signs that rewards are making the learner anxious, such as rushed or abandoned sessions.
gamification-reward-optimization.\\kappa: How heavily anxiety signals are penalised compared with learning time.

mastery-curriculum-sequencing-rl.\\mathrm{mastery}: The learner's mastery of skills; Delta mastery_t is the improvement at step t.
mastery-curriculum-sequencing-rl.\\pi: The policy that picks the next lesson.
mastery-curriculum-sequencing-rl.\\Delta: The change in mastery at step t.

learning-outcome-uplift-modeling.Y: The learning outcome: Y(1) if the learner receives the intervention and Y(0) if not.
learning-outcome-uplift-modeling.\\hat{\\tau}: The estimated causal effect of the intervention for a learner with features x.

accessibility-alt-text-and-captioning.\\text{image,context}: The image and surrounding page text the description is generated from.
accessibility-alt-text-and-captioning.\\mathrm{Hallucination}: Penalty for describing things that are not in the image.

student-pii-redaction-learning-data.\\mathrm{CE}_{\\text{NER}}: Cross-entropy for recognising personal information (names, ids) in text.
student-pii-redaction-learning-data.\\mathrm{RecallBoost}: Penalty for missing a personal detail, set so that recall is favoured over precision.

grading-triage-for-teacher-workload.\\text{manual hours}: Hours teachers spend grading by hand, which the system tries to minimise.

oral-exam-viva-llm.\\text{rubric,dialogue}: The marking rubric and the conversation so far.
oral-exam-viva-llm.\\mathrm{RubricMisalign}: Penalty when questions or judgements stray from the rubric.

code-plagiarism-detection.\\text{same logic}: The pairing label: 1 if two programs implement the same logic, even with renamed variables or reordered code.
code-plagiarism-detection.\\mathrm{BCE}: Binary cross-entropy on whether a pair is plagiarised.

classroom-vision-engagement-analytics.\\text{activity}: The classroom activity label, such as writing, listening or group work.
classroom-vision-engagement-analytics.p: The predicted probability of each activity.

adaptive-reading-text-simplification.\\text{level}: The target reading level the text is simplified to.
adaptive-reading-text-simplification.\\mathrm{MeaningDrift}: Penalty when the simplified text changes the meaning of the original.

vocabulary-level-estimation.k: Whether the learner knows word w: 1 if known.
vocabulary-level-estimation.\\hat{p}: The predicted probability that the learner knows word w.
vocabulary-level-estimation.\\sigma: Sigmoid function: squashes the difference of ability and difficulty into a probability.

learning-analytics-teacher-insights.\\text{insights by teacher action}: Insights ranked by whether teachers acted on them, so the model learns which insights are useful.

credit-default-survival-modeling.\\delta: Event indicator: 1 if borrower i defaulted, 0 if still performing at the end of observation (censored).
credit-default-survival-modeling.h: The hazard: the chance of default at time u given the borrower has not defaulted yet.
credit-default-survival-modeling.t: The time at which borrower i defaulted or was last observed.
credit-default-survival-modeling.d: The integration variable du: a tiny step in time.

aml-graph-anomaly-detection.z: The latent representation of the transaction graph learned by the model.
aml-graph-anomaly-detection.\\beta: Weight on the KL regularisation term: how strongly it counts against the main objective.
aml-graph-anomaly-detection.\\mathcal{L}_{\\text{BCE}}: Binary cross-entropy on whether an account or transaction is suspicious.
aml-graph-anomaly-detection.q: The encoder's distribution over z given the graph; p(z) is the prior it is pushed towards.

transaction-monitoring-alert-triage-llm.\\text{evidence}: The transactions and customer facts the narrative must be based on.
transaction-monitoring-alert-triage-llm.\\mathrm{CitationMiss}: Penalty for sentences in the narrative that do not cite a transaction or record.
transaction-monitoring-alert-triage-llm.\\gamma: Weight on the citation penalty: how strongly it counts against the main objective.

synthetic-identity-fraud-detection.z: The learned embedding of a node (identity): z_u for identity u.
synthetic-identity-fraud-detection.E: The set of edges (links) between identities.
synthetic-identity-fraud-detection.\\mathcal{L}_{\\text{focal}}: Focal loss on whether an identity is synthetic.

credit-scoring-thin-file-alt-data.\\mathrm{MonotonicityPenalty}: Penalty when predicted risk moves in the wrong direction as a feature improves (for example, risk rising as income rises).
credit-scoring-thin-file-alt-data.\\lambda: Weights on the penalties: lambda_1 for monotonicity and lambda_2 for demographic parity.

loan-underwriting-copilot.\\text{docs}: The applicant's documents the assistant reads.
loan-underwriting-copilot.\\mathrm{NumericMismatch}: Penalty when a number in the output differs from the number in the source document.

dynamic-credit-limit-optimization.\\text{revenue}: Interest and fee revenue earned at step t.
dynamic-credit-limit-optimization.c: The cost of capital charged per unit of capital held.
dynamic-credit-limit-optimization.\\text{capital}: Capital held against the credit line at step t.

collections-propensity-and-next-best-act.a: An action (such as call, text or offer) among those available.
collections-propensity-and-next-best-act.\\mathrm{Cost}: Cost of the actions the policy takes.
collections-propensity-and-next-best-act.\\hat{\\tau}: Estimated benefit of action a for customer i, relative to doing nothing.
collections-propensity-and-next-best-act.\\pi: The policy: the probability of choosing action a for customer x_i.

payment-routing-optimization.\\text{regret}: The reward lost at round t by not choosing the best route.
payment-routing-optimization.\\mu: Expected success rate of a route: mu*_x for the best route in context x and mu_{a_t,x_t} for the route chosen.
payment-routing-optimization.a: The payment route (processor) chosen at round t.

payment-authorization-rate-uplift.\\text{order value}: The value of the order; the weight w_i grows with it, so errors on large orders cost more.
payment-authorization-rate-uplift.\\hat{p}: The model's predicted probability that the payment is authorised.

chargeback-dispute-prediction-and-automa.\\text{amount}: The transaction amount, raised to the power 0.5 so that large amounts count more without dominating.

merchant-risk-scoring-onboarding.\\mathrm{ExpectedCostGap}: Penalty for the difference between the expected cost of the model's decisions and the best achievable cost.

sanctions-name-screening-fuzzy-matching.a: The anchor: a name from the customer or counterparty.
sanctions-name-screening-fuzzy-matching.p: The positive: a sanctions-list name that truly matches the anchor.
sanctions-name-screening-fuzzy-matching.n: The negative: a different name that does not match.
sanctions-name-screening-fuzzy-matching.\\text{match}: The label: 1 if two names refer to the same entity.

customer-support-chatbot-banking.\\text{KB}: The knowledge base of approved banking information the chatbot answers from.
customer-support-chatbot-banking.\\mathrm{PolicyViolation}: Penalty for answers that break banking policy or give prohibited advice.

financial-document-extraction-invoices.\\mathrm{CE}_{\\text{token}}: Cross-entropy on labelling each token with the right field (amount, date, vendor).
financial-document-extraction-invoices.\\mathrm{ArithmeticConsistency}: Penalty when extracted line items do not add up to the extracted total.

personal-finance-categorisation.\\mathrm{UserCorrectionConsistency}: Penalty when the model ignores categories the user has previously corrected.

spend-insights-and-nudges-recommender.r: Whether user u responded to nudge n: r_{un} is 1 if they acted on it.
spend-insights-and-nudges-recommender.s: The model's score for showing nudge n to user u.
spend-insights-and-nudges-recommender.\\sigma: Sigmoid function: turns the score into a probability.
spend-insights-and-nudges-recommender.\\mathrm{FatiguePenalty}: Penalty for sending too many nudges to the same person.
spend-insights-and-nudges-recommender.n: A nudge (message) that could be shown.

fraud-ring-detection-community.z: The embedding of an account: z_u for account u.
fraud-ring-detection-community.E: The set of observed links between accounts.
fraud-ring-detection-community.w: An account not linked to u (a negative sample).
fraud-ring-detection-community.\\mathrm{Modularity}: Penalty that rewards dense groups of connected accounts, so rings form clusters.
fraud-ring-detection-community.\\sigma: Sigmoid function: turns the similarity of two embeddings into a probability that the accounts are linked.

mule-account-detection.\\mathrm{GraphSmoothness}: Penalty when connected accounts get very different mule scores.
mule-account-detection.p: The predicted mule probability of an account.
mule-account-detection.y: The label: 1 if the account is a mule.

sepsis-early-warning.w: A weight per time step that is larger in the 6 hours before sepsis onset, so early warnings count most.
sepsis-early-warning.t: The hour of the patient's stay.
sepsis-early-warning.y: The label at hour t: 1 if sepsis begins within the next 6 hours.
sepsis-early-warning.p: The predicted probability of sepsis onset within 6 hours.

insider-trading-surveillance.\\mathrm{AlertBudgetPenalty}: Penalty when the model raises more alerts than the compliance team can review.
insider-trading-surveillance.\\mathrm{BCE}: Binary cross-entropy on whether a trading pattern is suspicious.
insider-trading-surveillance.\\mu: Weight on the alert-budget penalty: how strongly it counts against the main objective.

algorithmic-trading-signal-research.r: The asset's return h steps ahead: r_{t+h} is the realised return and its hat the model's forecast.
algorithmic-trading-signal-research.\\mathrm{Turnover}: Penalty on how much the portfolio trades, since trading costs eat returns.

market-regime-detection.s: The hidden market regime (such as calm or turbulent) at time t.
market-regime-detection.x: The observed market data at time t; x_{1:T} is the whole series.
market-regime-detection.p: A probability: p(s_t | s_{t-1}) is the chance of switching regimes and p(x_t | s_t) is how likely the data is in each regime.

volatility-forecasting.r: The asset's return at time t.
volatility-forecasting.\\hat{\\sigma}: The model's forecast of volatility (standard deviation of returns); its square is the variance.

order-execution-slippage-minimization.\\text{impact}: The market impact cost of trading q_t units at step t.
order-execution-slippage-minimization.q: The quantity traded at step t.
order-execution-slippage-minimization.\\text{risk}: The price risk of holding the unexecuted order at step t.
order-execution-slippage-minimization.\\pi: The execution policy that decides how much to trade each step.

market-making-quote-optimization.\\text{PnL}: Profit and loss earned by time T.
market-making-quote-optimization.q: The inventory (net position) the market maker holds at time t.
market-making-quote-optimization.T: The end of the trading period.
market-making-quote-optimization.d: The integration variable dt: a tiny step in time.

credit-card-offer-personalization.c: Whether user u accepted offer o: c_{uo} is 1 if accepted.
credit-card-offer-personalization.s: The model's score for showing offer o to user u.
credit-card-offer-personalization.\\sigma: Sigmoid function: turns the score into a probability.

insurance-claims-fraud-detection.v: A weight that grows with the claim amount, so errors on large claims cost more.
insurance-claims-fraud-detection.\\text{claim amount}: The value of the insurance claim.

insurance-claim-damage-estimation-vision.\\mathcal{L}_{\\text{seg}}: Segmentation loss: how well the damaged region of the vehicle is outlined.
insurance-claim-damage-estimation-vision.\\mathcal{L}_{\\text{cls}}: Classification loss: how well the type of damage is identified.

telematics-usage-based-insurance-scoring.\\text{claims}: The number of claims a driver made.
telematics-usage-based-insurance-scoring.\\hat{\\lambda}: The predicted claim rate for the driver.
telematics-usage-based-insurance-scoring.\\mathrm{Fairness}: Penalty when predictions treat protected groups unequally.

customer-lifetime-value-prediction.\\mathcal{LN}: The log-normal density: models how large the spend is when it is not zero.
customer-lifetime-value-prediction.\\pi: The probability that the customer's value is exactly zero.
customer-lifetime-value-prediction.\\mu: The mean of the logarithm of spend when it is positive.
customer-lifetime-value-prediction.\\sigma: The standard deviation of the logarithm of spend when it is positive.

reconciliation-matching-automation.\\mathrm{ManyToManyConsistency}: Penalty when matches are inconsistent in many-to-many cases, such as one payment covering several invoices that are not all matched.

regulatory-reporting-rag-copilot.\\text{retrieved}: The regulatory passages retrieved for the question.
regulatory-reporting-rag-copilot.\\mathrm{CitationError}: Penalty for citing a passage that does not support the sentence.

earnings-call-sentiment-and-esg-signals.\\mathrm{ConsistencyAcrossParaphrase}: Penalty when rewording the same sentence changes the predicted sentiment.

trade-surveillance-spoofing-detection.\\mathrm{TemporalSmoothness}: Penalty when scores for neighbouring moments in the order-book sequence jump around.

cross-border-fx-pricing-optimization.p: The price (FX margin) offered to the customer.
cross-border-fx-pricing-optimization.c: The cost to the bank of providing the transaction.
cross-border-fx-pricing-optimization.\\text{convert}: Whether the customer accepts the price and completes the transfer; its probability depends on price p and context x.

atm-cash-demand-forecasting.c: Cost per unit of error: c_u when cash runs out (under-forecast) and c_o when excess cash sits idle (over-forecast).
atm-cash-demand-forecasting.(\\cdot)^+: Positive part: counts only errors in the stated direction.

bnpl-risk-decisioning.\\text{order value}: The value of the order; w grows with it, so mistakes on large orders count more.

fraud-investigator-copilot-agent.\\text{tools}: The outputs of the investigation tools the agent has called.
fraud-investigator-copilot-agent.\\mathrm{UnsupportedClaim}: Penalty for statements that no tool output supports.

credit-model-drift-and-fairness-monitori.P: The reference distribution of a score or feature: P_i is the share of customers in bin i at training time.
credit-model-drift-and-fairness-monitori.Q: The current distribution: Q_i is the share in bin i today.
credit-model-drift-and-fairness-monitori.i: Index over bins of the score or feature.

readmission-risk-prediction.\\mathrm{GroupCalibration}: Penalty when predicted risk is miscalibrated for some patient groups, even if it is right overall.

pathology-slide-cancer-detection.\\mathrm{BCE}_{\\text{slide}}: Binary cross-entropy on whether the whole slide contains cancer.
pathology-slide-cancer-detection.\\mathrm{MIL\\text{-}attention}: Multiple-instance attention term: learns which small tiles of the slide to focus on, since only the slide label is known.

radiology-report-generation-llm.I: The medical image the report describes.
radiology-report-generation-llm.\\mathrm{CheXbertMismatch}: Penalty when findings in the generated report differ from those in the reference report, as extracted by the CheXbert labeller.

clinical-note-summarization-ambient-scri.x: The transcript of the clinical conversation.
clinical-note-summarization-ambient-scri.\\mathrm{UnsupportedFact}: Penalty for facts in the note that the conversation does not support.

icd-cpt-medical-coding-automation.c: A medical code (ICD or CPT); y_c is 1 if the code applies to the document.
icd-cpt-medical-coding-automation.\\mathrm{HierarchyPenalty}: Penalty when a child code is predicted without its parent in the coding hierarchy.

prior-authorization-automation.\\mathrm{PolicyViolation}: Penalty when the generated decision or letter contradicts the policy.

claims-denial-prediction.\\text{claim value}: The money value of the claim; w grows with it.

emergency-department-triage-nlp.\\mathrm{UnderTriagePenalty}: Extra penalty for assigning a lower urgency than the patient needs, which is far more dangerous than assigning too high.

drug-drug-interaction-and-adverse-event-.z: The learned embedding of a drug: z_i for drug i and z_j for drug j.
drug-drug-interaction-and-adverse-event-.R: A relation matrix that turns a pair of drug embeddings into an interaction score.
drug-drug-interaction-and-adverse-event-.\\mathrm{SeverityWeight}: Weight that makes dangerous interactions count more than mild ones.
drug-drug-interaction-and-adverse-event-.y: Whether drugs i and j interact: y_{ij} is 1 if they do.
drug-drug-interaction-and-adverse-event-.\\sigma: Sigmoid function: turns the score into a probability.

medication-adherence-prediction-and-nudg.\\text{adherence}: Whether the patient takes the medication as prescribed.
medication-adherence-prediction-and-nudg.B: The maximum number of nudges (contacts) allowed per patient or period.

drug-discovery-molecular-property-predic.m: A mask: m_{it} is 1 if molecule i has a measured value for property t and 0 if it is missing.
drug-discovery-molecular-property-predic.y: The measured value of property t for molecule i; the hat is the prediction.
drug-discovery-molecular-property-predic.\\mathrm{Evidential}: Penalty that trains the model to report its own uncertainty about each prediction.

virtual-screening-docking-surrogate.f: The surrogate model that predicts a docking score quickly.
virtual-screening-docking-surrogate.\\text{dock}: The expensive physics-based docking score the surrogate learns to imitate.

genomic-variant-pathogenicity-classifica.\\mathrm{EvidenceCalibration}: Penalty when predicted pathogenicity probabilities do not match the strength of clinical evidence categories.

single-cell-rna-cell-type-annotation.Z: The learned representation of cells from one experimental batch: Z_batch_a and Z_batch_b.
single-cell-rna-cell-type-annotation.\\mathrm{MMD}: Penalty for differences between the representations of two batches, which removes batch effects.

mental-health-triage-chatbot-safety.x: The user's message and conversation context.
mental-health-triage-chatbot-safety.\\mathrm{SafetyViolation}: Penalty when the reply is unsafe, for example missing a crisis signal or giving harmful advice.

symptom-checker-and-care-navigation.\\text{disposition}: The recommended level of care, from self-care up to emergency, treated as ordered grades.
symptom-checker-and-care-navigation.\\mathrm{UnderTriagePenalty}: Extra penalty for recommending a lower level of care than needed.

population-health-risk-stratification.\\hat{\\mu}: The predicted expected cost or utilisation for each patient.
population-health-risk-stratification.\\mathrm{FairnessGap}: Penalty when predictions differ systematically between demographic groups.

ckd-progression-forecasting.\\text{eGFR}: Estimated glomerular filtration rate, a kidney function measure: eGFR_{i,1:T} is patient i's series over T visits.
ckd-progression-forecasting.p: The model's probability of the observed series given the patient's features.
ckd-progression-forecasting.\\mathrm{Survival}: Survival loss for kidney failure events, handling patients not yet failed at the end of follow-up.

surgical-video-phase-recognition.\\mathrm{CE}_{\\text{phase}}: Cross-entropy for labelling each video frame with the surgical phase.
surgical-video-phase-recognition.\\mathrm{TemporalSmoothness}: Penalty for phase labels that flip back and forth between neighbouring frames.

ultrasound-guidance-and-measurement.\\mathcal{L}_{\\text{seg}}: Segmentation loss: how well the anatomical structure is outlined.
ultrasound-guidance-and-measurement.\\text{measure}: The clinical measurement taken from the image, such as a length or diameter.

patient-similarity-cohort-search.z: The learned embedding of a patient: z_p for the query patient and z_{p+} for a similar patient.
patient-similarity-cohort-search.p: A patient; p+ is a clinically similar patient.

clinical-decision-support-rag.\\text{evidence}: The guideline and literature passages retrieved for the question.
clinical-decision-support-rag.\\mathrm{CitationError}: Penalty for citing a source that does not support the statement.

patient-portal-message-triage.\\text{urgency}: The urgency level of the patient's message, treated as an ordered grade.

hospital-supply-forecasting.c: Cost per unit of shortfall (c_s, a stockout) and per unit of excess (c_e, wasted stock).
hospital-supply-forecasting.(\\cdot)^+: Positive part: counts only errors in the stated direction.

pharmacy-demand-and-expiry-forecasting.\\mathrm{ExpiryRisk}: Penalty for stock that will expire before it is sold.

ambulance-dispatch-and-response-time-opt.\\text{priority}: The urgency priority of call t.
ambulance-dispatch-and-response-time-opt.\\text{response}: The response time to call t.
ambulance-dispatch-and-response-time-opt.w: A weight that increases with call priority, so urgent calls matter most.

nurse-scheduling-optimization.\\text{understaffing}: The shortfall of nurses below the required level in shift s.
nurse-scheduling-optimization.\\text{preference violations}: Shifts that go against nurses' stated preferences.
nurse-scheduling-optimization.\\lambda: Weight on preference violations: how strongly it counts against the main objective.
nurse-scheduling-optimization.\\mu: Weight on overtime: how strongly it counts against the main objective.

risk-adjustment-hcc-coding.\\mathrm{ComplianceRisk}: Penalty for coding conditions that the record does not support, which would create audit risk.

clinical-text-phi-redaction.\\mathrm{CE}_{\\text{token}}: Cross-entropy for labelling each token as personal health information or not.
clinical-text-phi-redaction.\\mathrm{RecallBoost}: Penalty for missing personal information, set so recall is favoured over precision.

federated-learning-multi-hospital.w: The shared model weights being learned.
federated-learning-multi-hospital.n: The number of patients at hospital k, with n the total.
federated-learning-multi-hospital.F: The local loss at hospital k.
federated-learning-multi-hospital.\\mu: Strength of the proximal term that stops local models drifting too far from the global one.
federated-learning-multi-hospital.w_t: The global model weights at the start of the round.

radiotherapy-autocontouring.\\mathrm{SurfaceDistance}: Penalty on the distance between predicted and true organ boundaries.

sleep-staging-from-wearables.\\mathrm{CE}_{\\text{stage}}: Cross-entropy for classifying each epoch into a sleep stage.
sleep-staging-from-wearables.\\mathrm{TemporalConsistency}: Penalty for implausible stage changes between neighbouring epochs.

patient-digital-twin-treatment-response.a: The treatment given: a=0 for control and a=1 for treated.
patient-digital-twin-treatment-response.Y: The outcome the patient would have under treatment a: Y^(a).
patient-digital-twin-treatment-response.\\Phi: The learned representation of the patient's features; the IPM term makes treated and control groups look alike in this space.
patient-digital-twin-treatment-response.\\mathrm{IPM}: A distance between the treated and control distributions, used to reduce selection bias.

visual-search-shop-the-look.f: The embedding network: f(a), f(p), f(n) are the embeddings of anchor, positive and negative images.
visual-search-shop-the-look.p: The positive: an image of the same or a matching product.
visual-search-shop-the-look.n: The negative: an image of a different product.
visual-search-shop-the-look.\\mathcal{L}_{\\text{det}}: Detection loss: how well items in the image are found and boxed.

dynamic-pricing-optimization.c: The unit cost of item i.
dynamic-pricing-optimization.D: The predicted demand for item i at price p_i in context x_i.
dynamic-pricing-optimization.p: The price chosen for item i, the thing being optimised; p^min and p^max are the lowest and highest allowed prices.
dynamic-pricing-optimization.x: Context features such as day, stock and competitor prices.

markdown-clearance-optimization.m: The markdown (discount fraction) applied at time t.
markdown-clearance-optimization.c: The unit cost of the item.
markdown-clearance-optimization.S: The number of units that must be sold by the end of the clearance period.
markdown-clearance-optimization.p: The original price: p_0 is the price before markdowns.
markdown-clearance-optimization.q: Expected units sold at time t given markdown m_t.
markdown-clearance-optimization.T: The number of time periods in the clearance window.

promotion-uplift-and-coupon-targeting.\\text{policy}: The decision rule: give the coupon (1) only when estimated uplift exceeds its cost.
promotion-uplift-and-coupon-targeting.c: The cost of giving the coupon.
promotion-uplift-and-coupon-targeting.Y: The observed outcome for customer i.
promotion-uplift-and-coupon-targeting.W: Treatment indicator: 1 if the customer got the coupon.
promotion-uplift-and-coupon-targeting.\\mu: The model of the outcome for group W (T-learner).

new-product-cold-start-forecasting.\\mathrm{Analogue}: A comparable existing product used to guess a new product's sales.
new-product-cold-start-forecasting.\\mathrm{Consistency}: Penalty when the new product's forecast disagrees with its analogues' pattern.

inventory-replenishment-optimization.h: Holding cost per unit of leftover stock per period.
inventory-replenishment-optimization.I: Inventory at time t: I^+ is stock on hand and I^- is unmet demand (backorders).
inventory-replenishment-optimization.K: The fixed cost of placing an order.
inventory-replenishment-optimization.q: The quantity ordered at time t.

assortment-planning.x: Decision: x_i is 1 if item i is stocked, 0 if not.
assortment-planning.m: The profit margin of item i.
assortment-planning.D: The expected demand for item i given the chosen assortment.
assortment-planning.s: The shelf space item i needs.

customer-churn-and-repurchase-prediction.\\delta: Event indicator: 1 if customer i churned, 0 if still active at the end of observation.
customer-churn-and-repurchase-prediction.h: The hazard: the chance of churning at time t given still active.
customer-churn-and-repurchase-prediction.H: The cumulative hazard: the accumulated churn risk up to time t_i.
customer-churn-and-repurchase-prediction.t: The time customer i churned or was last observed.

customer-segmentation-embeddings.z: The learned embedding of a customer: z_u for customer u and z_u+ for a similar view of the same customer.
customer-segmentation-embeddings.\\mathrm{KMeans}: Clustering penalty that pulls each embedding towards its cluster centre so segments are compact.

conversational-shopping-assistant.\\text{catalogue}: The product catalogue the assistant may recommend from.
conversational-shopping-assistant.\\mathrm{OutOfCatalogue}: Penalty for recommending products that are not in the catalogue.

product-catalog-attribute-extraction-llm.\\mathrm{CE}_{\\text{token}}: Cross-entropy for labelling each token with the attribute it belongs to.
product-catalog-attribute-extraction-llm.\\mathrm{SchemaViolation}: Penalty when the extracted values do not fit the catalogue schema (wrong type or an invalid unit).

product-matching-and-deduplication.\\mathrm{TransitiveClosurePenalty}: Penalty when matches are not consistent: if A matches B and B matches C, A should match C.

return-fraud-and-abuse-detection.\\text{item value}: The value of the returned item; w grows with it.

checkout-payment-risk-ecommerce.c: The cost of a mistake: c_FN for letting a fraudulent order through and c_FP for blocking a genuine one.
checkout-payment-risk-ecommerce.y: The label: 1 if the order is fraudulent.
checkout-payment-risk-ecommerce.p: The calibrated probability that the order is fraudulent.

counterfeit-product-detection.\\text{genuine}: An embedding of a genuine product listing.
counterfeit-product-detection.\\text{fake}: An embedding of a counterfeit listing, pushed away from genuine ones.
counterfeit-product-detection.\\mathrm{BCE}: Binary cross-entropy on whether a listing is counterfeit.

size-and-fit-recommendation.\\text{fit class}: The fit outcome reported by the customer: too small, true to size or too large.
size-and-fit-recommendation.\\mathrm{OrdinalPenalty}: Extra penalty when the predicted fit is far from the true fit on the small-to-large scale.

review-summarization-and-q-and-a.\\mathrm{AspectCoverage}: Penalty when the summary leaves out important aspects mentioned in the reviews (battery life, fit, price).
review-summarization-and-q-and-a.x: The reviews the summary is based on.

send-time-optimization.r: Reward for engagement at step t, for example an open or click.
send-time-optimization.\\mathbb{1}: Indicator that the customer opted out at step t.
send-time-optimization.\\kappa: How heavily an opt-out is penalised compared with engagement.
send-time-optimization.\\pi: The policy that chooses when to send.

loyalty-offer-optimization.\\text{margin}: Profit margin earned at step t.
loyalty-offer-optimization.\\text{cost}: The cost of the offer at step t.
loyalty-offer-optimization.B: The loyalty budget: total offer cost must stay below it.

store-traffic-and-staffing-forecast.\\mathrm{ScheduleChurn}: Penalty for changing staff schedules that were already published.

competitor-price-intelligence.\\mathrm{AttributeConflict}: Penalty when matched products disagree on key attributes such as size or pack count.

search-relevance-llm-judge-evaluation.r: The relevance grade for result i: the hat is the judge's grade and r_human the human grade.
search-relevance-llm-judge-evaluation.d: The document (product) shown for the query.
search-relevance-llm-judge-evaluation.\\mathrm{Calibration}: Penalty when the LLM judge's grades disagree with human grades on average.

sponsored-products-ads-ranking.v: The value of a conversion to the advertiser.
sponsored-products-ads-ranking.q: The predicted probability of a purchase given a click.
sponsored-products-ads-ranking.y_{\\text{click}}: The label: 1 if the ad was clicked.
sponsored-products-ads-ranking.y_{\\text{conv}}: The label: 1 if the click led to a purchase.

out-of-stock-substitution.j: A substitute the shopper did not accept.
out-of-stock-substitution.\\mathrm{AcceptanceCalibration}: Penalty when predicted acceptance rates do not match how often shoppers accept substitutes.

fresh-produce-waste-forecasting.c: Cost per unit of waste (c_w) or shortage (c_s).
fresh-produce-waste-forecasting.\\hat{q}: The forecast quantity to order or stock.
fresh-produce-waste-forecasting.\\mathrm{ShelfLifePenalty}: Penalty for ordering more than can be sold before the produce spoils.

gift-recommendations-llm.\\mathrm{GroundingMiss}: Penalty when the recommended gift is not grounded in the real catalogue and the stated preferences.

category-page-ranking.\\mathrm{ListwisePenalty}: Penalty on the quality of the whole ordered list, for example diversity or position-weighted relevance.

buy-box-seller-ranking.\\text{conversion}: The label: 1 if the shopper bought from the offer.
buy-box-seller-ranking.\\mathrm{FairnessPenalty}: Penalty for unfairly favouring some sellers when offers are otherwise similar.

order-routing-fulfilment-selection.a: The fulfilment option chosen, such as which warehouse or store ships the order.
order-routing-fulfilment-selection.\\text{ship cost}: The cost of shipping from option a.
order-routing-fulfilment-selection.\\text{delay}: The expected delivery delay of option a.
order-routing-fulfilment-selection.\\text{opportunity cost of stock}: The value of the stock if it were kept for other orders instead.
order-routing-fulfilment-selection.\\lambda: Weight on delay: how strongly it counts against the main objective.
order-routing-fulfilment-selection.\\mu: Weight on stock opportunity cost: how strongly it counts against the main objective.

pre-purchase-return-risk.\\text{return cost}: The cost of a return including shipping and handling; w grows with it.

b2b-saas-churn-prediction.\\delta: Event indicator: 1 if the account churned, 0 if still active at the end of observation.
b2b-saas-churn-prediction.h: The hazard: the chance of churn at time t given the account is still active.
b2b-saas-churn-prediction.H: The cumulative hazard up to time t_i.
b2b-saas-churn-prediction.t: The time the account churned or was last observed.

account-health-scoring.\\text{retain}: The label: 1 if the account renewed.
account-health-scoring.\\mathrm{MonotonicityPenalty}: Penalty when the health score falls even though a positive signal, such as more usage, increased.

expansion-and-upsell-propensity.\\text{ARR potential}: The annual recurring revenue an expansion could add; w grows with it.

lead-to-account-matching.\\text{same entity}: The label: 1 if a lead and an account are the same company.
lead-to-account-matching.\\mathrm{TransitivityPenalty}: Penalty when matches are inconsistent across a group of records.

pricing-and-packaging-optimization.\\text{buy}: Whether a customer in segment s buys at price p.
pricing-and-packaging-optimization.p: The price chosen, the thing being optimised.
pricing-and-packaging-optimization.c: The unit cost of serving a customer.
pricing-and-packaging-optimization.x: Segment features: x_s for segment s.

revenue-and-pipeline-forecasting.\\text{deal win}: The label: 1 if a sales opportunity is won.

sales-call-summarization-and-coaching.\\text{transcript}: The transcript of the sales call.
sales-call-summarization-and-coaching.\\mathrm{UnsupportedFact}: Penalty for statements in the summary that the call does not support.

customer-support-copilot.\\text{ticket,KB}: The customer's ticket and the knowledge-base articles.
customer-support-copilot.\\mathrm{PolicyViolation}: Penalty when a suggested reply breaks support policy.

help-center-deflection-rag.\\text{docs}: The help-centre articles retrieved for the question.
help-center-deflection-rag.\\mathrm{Hallucination}: Penalty for statements not supported by the retrieved articles.

in-app-ai-copilot.\\text{context,tools}: The state of the app and the tools the copilot may use.
in-app-ai-copilot.\\mathrm{UnsafeAction}: Penalty when the copilot proposes an action that is destructive or not permitted.

natural-language-to-sql.\\mathrm{ExecutionMismatch}: Penalty when the generated SQL returns different results from the reference query.

code-completion-assistant.\\text{context}: The code around the cursor (before and after) that the model completes.

automated-code-review-assistant.\\text{diff,context}: The code change and the surrounding repository context.
automated-code-review-assistant.\\mathrm{FalsePositive}: Penalty for review comments that are wrong or noisy.

test-generation-and-pr-description.\\text{code}: The code change the tests and description are written for.
test-generation-and-pr-description.\\mathrm{TestFailure}: Penalty when the generated tests do not run or fail on correct code.

microservice-root-cause-analysis.\\text{root cause}: The label: which service or component caused the incident.

log-anomaly-detection.\\text{template sequence}: The sequence of log message templates (the message pattern with variable parts removed); a rare or unlikely sequence is flagged as an anomaly.

alert-noise-reduction.\\text{actionable}: The label: 1 if an alert led to action by an engineer, 0 if it was noise.
alert-noise-reduction.\\mathrm{ClusterPurity}: Penalty when a cluster of grouped alerts mixes unrelated alerts.

capacity-forecasting-and-autoscaling.\\text{cost}: The infrastructure cost of the capacity provisioned.
capacity-forecasting-and-autoscaling.\\text{capacity}: The amount of compute provisioned in advance for the forecast load.

flaky-test-detection.\\text{flaky}: The label: 1 if a test passes and fails without a code change.

predictive-test-selection.\\text{test fails}: Whether the test fails on this change.
predictive-test-selection.\\text{change,test}: The code change and the test being considered.

deployment-risk-prediction.\\text{incident}: The label: 1 if the deployment caused an incident.
deployment-risk-prediction.\\text{blast radius}: How many users or services a failure would affect; w grows with it.

feature-flag-rollout-safety.\\text{ramp speed}: How quickly the feature is rolled out to more users, which the policy tries to maximise.
feature-flag-rollout-safety.\\text{harm}: The measured harm of the new feature, such as higher errors.
feature-flag-rollout-safety.\\delta: The largest harm that is acceptable.
feature-flag-rollout-safety.\\alpha: The acceptable probability of exceeding that harm.

enterprise-search-relevance.s: The model's relevance scores for the candidate documents.
enterprise-search-relevance.d: A document: d+ is a relevant document for query q.
enterprise-search-relevance.\\mathrm{InfoNCE}: Contrastive loss that pulls queries towards their relevant documents.

email-assistant-auto-reply.\\text{thread,style}: The email thread and the user's writing style the reply is conditioned on.

meeting-notes-and-action-items.\\mathrm{OwnerError}: Penalty for assigning an action item to the wrong person.

behavioral-cohort-segmentation.\\mathrm{ReconstructionLoss}: How well an autoencoder rebuilds user behaviour from its compressed embedding.
behavioral-cohort-segmentation.z: The compressed embedding of a user's behaviour.
behavioral-cohort-segmentation.\\mathrm{ClusterLoss}: Penalty that pulls embeddings towards their cluster centres so cohorts are distinct.

data-quality-anomaly-detection.m: The data quality metric at time t, such as row count or null rate.
data-quality-anomaly-detection.\\mu: The predicted normal value of the metric.
data-quality-anomaly-detection.\\sigma: The predicted normal spread of the metric.

llm-schema-matching-data-integration.\\text{column}: The embedding of a source column.
llm-schema-matching-data-integration.\\text{target field}: The embedding of the matching field in the target schema.
llm-schema-matching-data-integration.\\mathrm{ValidationFailure}: Penalty when mapped data fails validation checks such as type or range.

learned-trace-sampling.v: The value of keeping trace r, for example how informative it is.
learned-trace-sampling.\\text{keep}: Whether trace r is kept (1) or dropped (0).

sre-runbook-automation-agent.\\text{incident}: The incident description and telemetry the agent reads.
sre-runbook-automation-agent.\\mathrm{UnsafeAction}: Penalty when the agent proposes a remediation that is risky or not allowed.

ml-platform-drift-monitoring.P: The reference distribution: P_i is the share in bin i at training time.
ml-platform-drift-monitoring.Q: The current distribution: Q_i is the share in bin i now.

llm-gateway-routing-and-cost-optimizatio.\\text{cost}: The cost of calling the chosen model.
llm-gateway-routing-and-cost-optimizatio.m: The model chosen for the request.
llm-gateway-routing-and-cost-optimizatio.\\lambda: Penalty for answers below the quality threshold.

llm-app-eval-and-regression-testing.\\text{score}: The overall quality score of the application on the test set.
llm-app-eval-and-regression-testing.\\mathrm{Judge}: The judge's grade for an answer to input x_i, calibrated against human labels.

rag-quality-monitoring.\\text{grounded}: The label: 1 if the answer is supported by the retrieved sources.

cdp-identity-resolution-saas.\\text{same person}: The label: 1 if two customer records belong to the same person.
cdp-identity-resolution-saas.\\mathrm{TransitivityPenalty}: Penalty when matches contradict each other: if A matches B and B matches C, then A should match C.

developer-docs-assistant.\\text{docs}: The documentation passages retrieved for the question.
developer-docs-assistant.\\mathrm{NonExistentAPI}: Penalty when the answer mentions an endpoint or function that does not exist.

personalized-onboarding-paths.\\text{activation}: Whether the new user reaches the activation milestone.
personalized-onboarding-paths.\\gamma: Discount factor: earlier activation is worth more.

customer-success-qbr-agent.\\text{data}: The account usage and health data the report must be based on.
customer-success-qbr-agent.\\mathrm{NumericError}: Penalty when a number in the report differs from the source data.

last-mile-route-optimization.R: The set of routes for all vehicles; each route r is a list of stops.
last-mile-route-optimization.c: Cost coefficients: c_dist per unit distance and c_late per unit of lateness.
last-mile-route-optimization.\\text{lateness}: How late the vehicle arrives at stops, in expectation over uncertain travel times.

vehicle-routing-with-time-windows.c: The fixed cost of using vehicle k.
vehicle-routing-with-time-windows.d: The distance between stops i and j.
vehicle-routing-with-time-windows.x: Decision: x_{ijk} is 1 if vehicle k drives from stop i to stop j.
vehicle-routing-with-time-windows.\\mathrm{Lateness}: Penalty for arriving after a customer's time window.

dynamic-dispatch-for-ride-gig-couriers.\\text{wait}: The customer's waiting time at step t.
dynamic-dispatch-for-ride-gig-couriers.\\text{detour}: The extra distance the courier drives at step t.
dynamic-dispatch-for-ride-gig-couriers.\\text{fairness}: A fairness measure, such as an even spread of jobs among couriers, at step t.
dynamic-dispatch-for-ride-gig-couriers.\\lambda: Weight on detour: how strongly it counts against the main objective.
dynamic-dispatch-for-ride-gig-couriers.\\mu: Weight on fairness: how strongly it counts against the main objective.

warehouse-slotting-optimization.f: How often SKU s is picked.
warehouse-slotting-optimization.d: The distance of location l from the dispatch point.
warehouse-slotting-optimization.a: How often SKUs s and s' are ordered together.
warehouse-slotting-optimization.\\mathrm{dist}: The distance between the locations of two SKUs.
warehouse-slotting-optimization.x: Decision: x_{sl} is 1 if SKU s is placed in location l.

pick-path-and-wave-planning.\\mathrm{PathLength}: The distance pickers walk to complete wave w.
pick-path-and-wave-planning.\\mathrm{Lateness}: Penalty for orders completed after their cut-off.
pick-path-and-wave-planning.\\mathrm{Congestion}: Penalty for too many pickers in the same aisle.
pick-path-and-wave-planning.w: A wave: a batch of orders released together.
pick-path-and-wave-planning.\\lambda: Weight on lateness: how strongly it counts against the main objective.
pick-path-and-wave-planning.\\mu: Weight on congestion: how strongly it counts against the main objective.

warehouse-robot-fleet-orchestration.\\text{conflicts}: Collisions or deadlocks between robots at step t.

pallet-and-load-dimensioning-vision.\\text{dims}: The true length, width and height of the pallet.
pallet-and-load-dimensioning-vision.\\widehat{dims}: The model's estimate of the dimensions.
pallet-and-load-dimensioning-vision.\\mathrm{ShapeConsistency}: Penalty when the estimated dimensions describe an impossible shape.

container-port-yard-planning.\\text{rehandles}: The number of extra container moves needed to reach container c.
container-port-yard-planning.\\text{turnaround}: How long ships and trucks wait in port.

container-dwell-time-prediction.\\delta: Event indicator: 1 if the container left the yard, 0 if still there at the end of observation.
container-dwell-time-prediction.h: The hazard: the chance the container leaves at time t given it is still in the yard.
container-dwell-time-prediction.H: The cumulative hazard up to time t_i.
container-dwell-time-prediction.t: The time the container left or was last observed.

freight-rate-prediction-and-pricing.r: The freight rate; the hat is the model's predicted rate.
freight-rate-prediction-and-pricing.\\mathrm{WinProbCalibration}: Penalty when predicted win probabilities at a given price do not match how often bids win.

carrier-selection-and-tendering.c: The cost of carrier a: c_a and c^fail the cost if the shipment fails.
carrier-selection-and-tendering.p: The probability that carrier a accepts the load.
carrier-selection-and-tendering.\\text{service risk}: The risk of poor service by carrier a.
carrier-selection-and-tendering.\\lambda: Weight on the risk of rejection: how strongly it counts against the main objective.
carrier-selection-and-tendering.\\mu: Weight on service risk: how strongly it counts against the main objective.

supply-chain-news-event-monitoring-llm.\\text{articles}: The news articles the system reads.
supply-chain-news-event-monitoring-llm.\\mathrm{Unsupported}: Penalty for statements the articles do not support.

inventory-optimization-multi-echelon.h: The holding cost per unit at node n of the supply network.
inventory-optimization-multi-echelon.I: Inventory at node n: I^+ is the stock on hand.
inventory-optimization-multi-echelon.\\text{stockout}: The event that node n runs out of stock; its probability must stay below alpha_n.
inventory-optimization-multi-echelon.\\alpha: The maximum acceptable stock-out probability at node n.
inventory-optimization-multi-echelon.n: A node (warehouse or store) in the multi-echelon network.

safety-stock-and-service-level-optimizat.\\mathrm{SL}: Service level of item i as a function of its safety stock: the probability of not running out.
safety-stock-and-service-level-optimizat.s: The safety stock held for item i, the thing being optimised.
safety-stock-and-service-level-optimizat.c: The cost of holding one unit of item i.
safety-stock-and-service-level-optimizat.w: The importance weight of item i.

production-planning-and-scheduling.T: The tardiness of job j: how late it finishes beyond its due date.
production-planning-and-scheduling.\\text{setup}: The setup (changeover) time or cost on machine m.
production-planning-and-scheduling.w: The importance weight of job j.

predictive-maintenance-fleet.\\mathrm{BCE}: Binary cross-entropy on whether the vehicle fails within the horizon.
predictive-maintenance-fleet.\\mathrm{CostWeighting}: Weight that makes missed failures on costly or critical vehicles count more.

cold-chain-temperature-excursion-predict.T: The temperature at time t+h: the hat is the model's predicted temperature.
cold-chain-temperature-excursion-predict.y: The label: 1 if the temperature goes out of range at t+h.

fuel-consumption-and-eco-routing.F: Fuel consumed on a trip; the hat is the model's prediction.

driver-behaviour-and-safety-scoring.\\text{incidents}: The number of safety incidents a driver had.
driver-behaviour-and-safety-scoring.\\hat{\\lambda}: The predicted incident rate for the driver.

customs-hs-code-classification.\\mathrm{CE}_{\\ell}: Cross-entropy for predicting the code at hierarchy level l (chapter, heading, subheading).
customs-hs-code-classification.\\ell: Index over levels of the code hierarchy.
customs-hs-code-classification.\\mathrm{HierarchyConsistency}: Penalty when a predicted detailed code does not belong under the predicted higher-level code.

freight-invoice-audit.\\text{amount}: The invoice amount; w grows with it.

reverse-logistics-returns-flow-optimizat.\\text{recovery}: The value recovered from the returned item, for example resale value.
reverse-logistics-returns-flow-optimizat.a: The disposition chosen: resell, refurbish, liquidate or recycle.
reverse-logistics-returns-flow-optimizat.\\text{cost}: The cost of handling the return with option a.

delivery-time-slot-optimization.\\text{conv}: The probability the customer completes the purchase given the slots and prices shown.
delivery-time-slot-optimization.\\text{margin}: The margin earned on the order.
delivery-time-slot-optimization.\\text{cost}: The delivery cost of the chosen slot.
delivery-time-slot-optimization.p: The slot price or offer shown to the customer.

first-attempt-delivery-failure-predictio.c: The cost of a redelivery attempt; the loss weights failures by it.

drone-and-av-delivery-path-planning.c: Cost per step: c_energy for energy used, c_risk for risk and c_time for delay.
drone-and-av-delivery-path-planning.\\lambda: Weights lambda_1 on risk and lambda_2 on time.

supply-chain-digital-twin-simulation.\\mathrm{Distance}: A measure of how far the simulation's behaviour is from the real system's.
supply-chain-digital-twin-simulation.S: A summary of system behaviour: S_theta from the simulator with parameters theta and S_observed from real data.

order-promising-atp-optimization.v: The value of promising order o.
order-promising-atp-optimization.\\text{promise}: Whether order o is promised (1) or not (0).

cross-dock-scheduling.\\text{dwell}: How long freight waits at the dock in period t.
cross-dock-scheduling.\\text{walking}: The distance workers walk moving freight.
cross-dock-scheduling.\\lambda: Weight on walking distance: how strongly it counts against the main objective.
cross-dock-scheduling.\\mu: Weight on lateness: how strongly it counts against the main objective.

load-consolidation-and-bin-packing.\\text{containers}: The number of containers or trucks used, which the plan tries to minimise.
load-consolidation-and-bin-packing.\\text{unload penalties}: Extra cost when loads are packed so that unloading order is awkward.

supplier-quality-defect-prediction.\\text{impact}: The business impact of a defect from the supplier; w grows with it.

bom-and-part-matching-llm.\\text{part}: The embedding of a part description from the bill of materials.
bom-and-part-matching-llm.\\text{catalogue part}: The embedding of the matching catalogue part.
bom-and-part-matching-llm.\\mathrm{SchemaViolation}: Penalty when the matched part fails catalogue rules such as unit or category.

contract-intelligence-llm.\\text{clauses}: The contract clauses the model reads.
contract-intelligence-llm.\\mathrm{ClauseMiss}: Penalty for failing to report a relevant clause.

demand-shaping-supply-aligned.\\text{unmet}: Demand that could not be served at step t.
demand-shaping-supply-aligned.\\text{excess}: Excess supply left over at step t.
demand-shaping-supply-aligned.\\lambda: Weight on unmet demand: how strongly it counts against the main objective.
demand-shaping-supply-aligned.\\mu: Weight on excess supply: how strongly it counts against the main objective.

carbon-footprint-estimation-logistics.E: The emissions of a shipment; the hat is the model's estimate.

cvr-prediction-delayed-feedback.p: The probability that the click eventually converts.
cvr-prediction-delayed-feedback.\\lambda: The rate of the conversion-delay distribution: a larger value means conversions usually happen sooner after the click.
cvr-prediction-delayed-feedback.d: The time elapsed since the click.
cvr-prediction-delayed-feedback.y: The label so far: 1 if a conversion has already been observed, 0 if not yet (it may still come).
cvr-prediction-delayed-feedback.e: Euler's number, base of the exponential delay model.

ltv-based-bidding.\\pi: The probability that the customer's lifetime value is exactly zero.
ltv-based-bidding.\\mu: The mean of the logarithm of value for customers who do spend.
ltv-based-bidding.\\sigma: The standard deviation of the logarithm of value for customers who do spend.

admissions-application-scoring-fairness.\\mu: Weight on the equalised-odds fairness penalty: how strongly it counts against the main objective.
admissions-application-scoring-fairness.\\lambda: Weight on the demographic-parity fairness penalty: how strongly it counts against the main objective.

account-takeover-detection.\\mu: Weight on the Brier (calibration) term: how strongly it counts against the main objective.
account-takeover-detection.w: A class weight: w_{y_i} is larger for the rare takeover class so it is not ignored.
account-takeover-detection.\\mathrm{Brier}: Brier score: the mean squared difference between predicted probability and the 0/1 outcome.

ledger-journal-entry-anomaly-audit.\\beta: Weight on the KL term that keeps the learned code close to a standard normal distribution: how strongly it counts against the main objective.
ledger-journal-entry-anomaly-audit.\\mathrm{KL}: Kullback-Leibler divergence: how far the learned code distribution is from the standard normal prior.

predictive-maintenance-warehouse-equipme.\\beta: Weight on the KL term that keeps the learned code close to a standard normal distribution: how strongly it counts against the main objective.
predictive-maintenance-warehouse-equipme.\\mathrm{KL}: Kullback-Leibler divergence: how far the learned code distribution is from the standard normal prior.

polygenic-risk-scoring.\\beta: The effect size of genetic variant j on the trait; the model learns one per variant.
polygenic-risk-scoring.\\tau: The prior spread of the effect of variant j: a small value shrinks that variant's effect towards zero.
polygenic-risk-scoring.X: The genotype matrix: each person's variants.
polygenic-risk-scoring.y: The measured trait or disease status.

portfolio-optimization-risk-parity.w: The portfolio weights: the share of capital held in each asset, the thing being optimised; w_0 is the current portfolio.
portfolio-optimization-risk-parity.\\Sigma: The covariance matrix of asset returns, which measures risk.
portfolio-optimization-risk-parity.\\mu: The vector of expected asset returns.
portfolio-optimization-risk-parity.\\lambda: How much expected return is valued against risk.
portfolio-optimization-risk-parity.\\kappa: Penalty on trading away from the current portfolio, which limits turnover.
