portfolio-optimization-risk-parity.\\|: Norm: the sum of absolute changes in weights (turnover).

retail-banking-churn-prediction.\\tau: Uplift: the causal effect of the retention offer on whether the customer stays, for a customer with features x.
retail-banking-churn-prediction.Y: The outcome: Y(1) if the customer gets the offer and Y(0) if not.

digital-onboarding-dropoff-prediction.\\tau: Uplift: the causal effect of an intervention on completing onboarding, for a user with features x.
digital-onboarding-dropoff-prediction.Y: The outcome: Y(1) with the intervention and Y(0) without.

cart-abandonment-and-basket-completion.\\tau: Uplift: the causal effect of the reminder or offer on completing the purchase.
cart-abandonment-and-basket-completion.Y: The outcome: Y(1) with the intervention and Y(0) without.

plg-activation-prediction.\\tau: Uplift: the causal effect of an intervention on activation for a user with features x.

incrementality-geo-experiments.w: The weight given to control region j in the synthetic control, chosen so the blend matches the treated region before the test.
incrementality-geo-experiments.y: The outcome in a region at time t: y_treat for the treated region and y_j for control region j.

delivery-promise-estimation.\\alpha: The quantile level (0.9): errors that make the promise too early are weighted 0.9 and too late 0.1, so the model learns the 90th percentile.
delivery-promise-estimation.\\hat{q}: The predicted delivery time at that quantile.
delivery-promise-estimation.(\\cdot)^+: Positive part: counts only errors in the stated direction.

procurement-price-forecasting.p: The price at time t+h: the hat is the forecast at quantile q.

placement-test-and-cold-start-onboarding.\\theta: The learner's true ability; the hat is the estimate, which should be accurate with as few questions as possible.

price-elasticity-causal-estimation.\\theta: The price elasticity: how much demand changes when price changes, allowed to depend on features X_i.
price-elasticity-causal-estimation.\\tilde{Y}: Demand with the part explained by other features removed.
price-elasticity-causal-estimation.\\tilde{T}: Price with the part explained by other features removed.

experimentation-cuped-sequential-testing.\\theta: The CUPED coefficient: how much of the outcome's variation is explained by the pre-experiment covariate, computed as Cov(Y,X)/Var(X).
experimentation-cuped-sequential-testing.\\hat{\\tau}_{\\text{CUPED}}: The variance-reduced estimate of the treatment effect.
experimentation-cuped-sequential-testing.X: The pre-experiment covariate (for example last month's spend) used to reduce noise.

dynamic-product-ads-feed-recs.s: The model's score for showing item i to user u.
dynamic-product-ads-feed-recs.j: Index over all candidate items the item is compared with.

handwritten-exam-ocr-grading.\\mathcal{L}_{\\text{layout}}: Layout loss: how well the page regions (answer boxes, question numbers) are found.

multilingual-lecture-captioning.\\mathcal{L}_{\\text{translation}}: Translation loss: how well the caption is translated into the target language.

kyc-document-verification-vision.\\mathcal{L}_{\\text{CE}}^{\\text{doc ty: Cross-entropy for recognising the type of identity document.
kyc-document-verification-vision.\\mathcal{L}_{\\text{BCE}}^{\\text{tampe: Binary cross-entropy for whether the document has been tampered with.
kyc-document-verification-vision.\\mathcal{L}_{\\text{OCR-CTC}}: CTC loss for reading the text on the document.

liveness-and-deepfake-selfie-detection.\\mathcal{L}_{\\text{SupCon}}: Supervised contrastive loss: pulls real selfies together and pushes spoof or deepfake selfies away from them.

dicom-image-deidentification.\\mathcal{L}_{\\text{OCR-det}}: Text-detection loss: how well burned-in text regions (names, dates) are located in the image.

shelf-monitoring-vision.\\mathcal{L}_{\\text{planogram}}: Planogram loss: penalty when detected shelf contents disagree with the planned layout.

checkout-free-store-vision.\\mathcal{L}_{\\text{reid}}: Re-identification loss: how well the same shopper is recognised across cameras.
checkout-free-store-vision.\\mathcal{L}_{\\text{action}}: Action loss: how well picking up or putting back items is recognised.
checkout-free-store-vision.\\mathcal{L}_{\\text{basket-consistency}: Penalty when the inferred basket is inconsistent with the sequence of actions.

virtual-try-on.\\mathcal{L}_{\\text{identity}}: Identity loss: penalty when the generated image changes the person's face or body.

visual-quality-inspection-line.\\mathcal{L}_{\\text{feature-distance}}: Feature-distance loss: keeps the representation of normal parts close together so that defects stand out.

spend-classification-taxonomy.\\mathrm{CE}: Cross-entropy for classifying a spend line into the category at one level of the taxonomy: L1 is the top level, L2 the middle level and L3 the most detailed.
